name: Sri Lanka (Eurocodes with the Sri Lankan wind zones)
edition: Eurocodes (recommended values) with the Sri Lankan wind zones
description: Sri Lankan practice (alpha 9 track C21): a thin pack that extends the built-in pack eurocodes (EN 1990, EN 1991, EN 1992-1-1, EN 1993 and the rest with the recommended values; no Sri Lankan National Annex values are reliably known to SAEngine, so none are set). Wind: the Sri Lankan wind zones 1-3 (Design of Buildings for High Winds, 1980: 49, 43 and 33 m/s 3-second gusts of normal structures) converted to the EN 1991-1-4 basic velocity vb,0 by 1/1.53 (SAEngine practice), for 16 towns. Seismic: not covered (no seismic code reliably known: zone 0, no earthquake cases; a project may enter agR). The legacy British Standards practice (BS 8110, CP 3) is the built-in pack bs8110 with a custom location. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md: the zones of the towns and the gust conversion are to be checked before design.
